about.title: About {brand} – Free, Private Online PDF Tools
about.desc: {brand} offers 140+ free PDF, image, QR and file tools that run entirely in your browser. No uploads, no sign-up, no limits.
about.html:
{brand} is a collection of free online tools for PDFs, images, QR codes, audio, video and data files. Unlike most online PDF sites, almost every tool here runs entirely inside your web browser. Your files are processed on your own device and are not uploaded to our servers.

Why we built it

People often need to merge, compress or convert a document quickly – for a job application, a government form or an email. Most sites ask you to upload private files, create an account, or wait out hourly limits. We wanted tools that are free, fast and private by design.

How it works

When you open a tool, your browser downloads the program code (built on open-source libraries such as pdf-lib and PDF.js). The work then happens locally. After a page has loaded, many tools keep working even if your connection drops.

Is it really free?

Yes. There are no paid plans, file limits or watermarks. The site may show unobtrusive ads in the future to cover hosting costs.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | {brand}
privacy.desc: How {brand} handles your data: files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.
privacy.html:
Last updated: October 2026

Your files

{brand} tools process files locally in your browser. The documents, images, audio and video you open are not uploaded to our servers and we cannot see them. Some tools download helper files (for example OCR language data or AI models) from our site; this only sends a normal web request, never your file.

Data we collect

Our hosting provider (Cloudflare) may keep standard technical logs such as IP address, browser type and pages requested, for security and performance. We do not sell personal data. We do not require accounts.

Cookies and local storage

We may store small preferences (such as your language) in your browser. If advertising or analytics are added in the future, this policy will be updated and, where required, consent will be requested.

Contact
